summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The FT Vest U.S. Equity Quarterly 15 Buffer ETF (SQBA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund aims to participate in the price movement of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (ticker: SPY), up to a cap while providing a buffer against the first 15% of losses. The fund resets its buffer and cap levels quarterly SQBA was launched on Aug 21, 2026 and is issued by First Trust.
